sloka: अद्य मद्बाणनिर्भिन्नैः प्रकीर्णैर्गतचेतनैः।करोमि वानरैर्युद्धे यत्नावेक्ष्यतलां महीम् ।। ६.९६.१९ ।।
transliteration: adya madbāṇanirbhinnaiḥ prakīrṇairgatacetanaiḥ।karomi vānarairyuddhe yatnāvekṣyatalāṁ mahīm ।। 6.96.19 ।।

translations.english: "Today, in the combat, my arrows will split open the Vanaras and ceased of life, they will be covering the earth. It will be possible to see the ground only with effort."
